## 재고 감소 로직 - 코드
[ 코드 ] Stock ```java @Entity public class Stock { @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id; private Long productId; private Long quantity; public Stock() { } public Stock(Long productId, Long quantity) { this.productId = productId; this.quantity = quantity; } public Long getQuantity() { return quantity; } public void decrease(Long quantity) { if (this.quantity - quantity < 0) { throw new RuntimeException("재고는 0개 미만이 될 수 없습니다."); } this.quantity -= quantity; } } ```
[ 코드 ] StockService ```java @Service public class StockService { private final StockRepository stockRepository; public StockService(StockRepository stockRepository) { this.stockRepository = stockRepository; } @Transactional public void decrease(Long id, Long qunntity) { // Stock 조회 // 재고를 감소한 뒤 // 갱신된 값을 저장 Stock stock = stockRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow(); stock.decrease(quantity); stockRepository.saveAndFlush(stock); } } ```
[ 코드 ] StockRepository ```java public interface StockRepository extends JpaRepository { } ```
- 테스트 ```java @SpringBootTest class StockServiceTest { @Autowired private StockService stockService; @Autowired private StockRepository stockRepository; @BeforeEach public void before() { stockRepository.saveAndFlush(new Stock(1L, 100L); } @AfterEach public void after(0 { stockRepository.deleteAll(); } @Test public void 재고감소() { stockService.decrease(1L, 1L); // id, quantity assertEquals(99. stock.getQuantity()); } } ```
